let b := (nth_partDenom_eq).1
let d_n := (GenContFract.of v).dens n
let d_n_plus_1 := (GenContFract.of v).dens (n + 1)
have h_denom_rel : d_n_plus_1 = d_n * b + (GenContFract.of v).nums n := by
  rw [GenContFract.dens_succ]
  exact nth_partDenom_eq
have h_order : d_n * b ≤ d_n_plus_1 := by
  rw [h_denom_rel]
  apply add_right_increasing
  apply mul_nonneg
  exact (GenContFract.of v).nums n ≥ 0
  exact (GenContFract.of v).dens n ≥ 0
exact h_order
